# claude-video vendored copy

Source: https://github.com/bradautomates/claude-video
License: MIT (see ./LICENSE)
Vendored at upstream commit: 755c157466738dda102c939158a0116b972925a3
Vendored on: 2026-05-07

## Directory rename

Upstream uses `claude-video` (with a dash). We vendor it as `claude_video` (underscore)
so it can be imported as a Python module: `from vendor.claude_video.scripts import frames`.

## Modifications from upstream

None on initial import. Future patches to support our pipeline will be tracked here
with comments referencing this file in the modified scripts.
